grid man-memory 7x61: 7 igniters walking at once

196 x 215

  • router / broadcaster one op in, three words out to every column at once. The strip spans the whole width so each column's pipe is a two-cell stub off its south wall, and it owns no other outgoing pipe — `S` would broadcast into that too.
  • collector strip `R` takes from any incoming pipe, so answers need no addressing. It is on the *bottom* on purpose: answer pipes never cross broadcast pipes, and every column's answer travels the same distance, so a later op's answer cannot overtake an earlier one.
  • input `0 addr` / `1 addr value`
  • output one word per READ
  • column 0: addr 0-60 its own igniter, its own `@`, walking at tick 0 like every other column's. It is handed 0 as a literal and counts up, so these decoders hold global addresses and the head above them decodes nothing.
  • repeater 0 `r S` three times: take a word off the strip, shout it at this column
  • column 1: addr 61-121 its own igniter, its own `@`, walking at tick 0 like every other column's. It is handed 61 as a literal and counts up, so these decoders hold global addresses and the head above them decodes nothing.
